resources.string: Phone control session
Shows the short phone-control session and its Pause and Return controls. Keep this on if you want to be able to stop the agent from another app.
Phone control pairing
Asks for the pairing port and the six-digit code from Android\'s wireless debugging screen.
Agent is using %1$s
Pause or come back to AndChamber at any time. Coming back to AndChamber always stops the session.
Pause
Paused
Paused. Return to AndChamber to check the last operation and grant control again.
Pausing…
Pausing. No new actions are accepted. The last action may still take effect.
Return to AndChamber
Pair with this phone
Android\'s wireless debugging screen is open. Choose \"Pair device with pairing code\" and type the port shown there here. The dialog stays open.
Pairing port
Type the six-digit code from Android\'s pairing dialog here. It is used once, never saved and never written to a chat.
Six-digit code
Pairing… one bounded attempt is running. Cancel if the dialog was closed.
Paired
Return to AndChamber and enter the connection port shown on the wireless debugging screen. Pairing alone does not connect.
The pairing code was refused. Check the code on the screen and pair again. Nothing was authorized.
The pairing port could not be reached. Reopen the pairing dialog, because its port changes, then try again.
This pairing port or address is not allowed. Use the port from this phone\'s own wireless debugging screen.
Pairing timed out. Nothing is connected; open the pairing dialog again when you want to retry.
Pairing did not complete. Nothing is connected. Android\'s own authorization, if any, was not changed by this app.
Cancel pairing
